get_domain_factory: get a Domain instance by name using get_domain with 'object_division' or 'trade' as the argument
generate_choices_object_division: generate all valid negotiation choices for an object division domain input using generate_choices
parse_context_domain: parse a context list into item counts and values using the parse_context method on a Domain instance
score_choice_domain: score a single agent's choice against its context using the score method on ObjectDivisionDomain
score_choices_multi_agent: score multiple agents' choices and check agreement using score_choices on ObjectDivisionDomain or ObjectTradeDomain
